subject: GreenField AI — buy cycle playbook & proposed MAP
messages:
From: Sasha Miller <sasha@greenfieldai.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-17 14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up and discovery call notes

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — Miguel and I found the latency/cost comparisons helpful. Quick note: procurement wants an outline of the buying steps (who needs to approve, what docs we need to provide) so we can map internal milestones.

Can you send a short MAP (mutual action plan) with owners and target dates? Also, Miguel asked about SOC 2 evidence and data retention options — can you include the relevant docs or links?

Best,
Sasha
Sasha Miller
Director of Platform Partnerships
GreenField AI

-----
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Miller <sasha@greenfieldai.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.t@greenfieldai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-17 15:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up and discovery call notes

Sasha — thanks for the call and the ask. I put together a first-pass MAP and included the two security/attachments you requested. See attachments: GF_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (playbook + milestone table) and GF_security_requirements.pdf (SOC2 pointers, retention options).

High-level recap and next actions (TL;DR):
- Economic buyer: Miguel is coordinating exec review; Sasha will surface the CFO (TBD name) for final approval.
- Security/legal: procurement wants SOC2 Type II and a data retention summary. We supplied the link in the attachment (see page 2).
- Procurement: expect a standard SOW + purchase order path; procurement asked for a procurement form we can fill out.

Proposed mutual action plan (first pass) — owners & target dates:
1) Confirm buying committee (names/roles) — owner: Sasha — target: 2026-05-21
2) Provide SOC2 + retention notes — owner: Connor (Redwood) — target: 2026-05-19 (attached)
3) Procurement form completed — owner: Miguel/Procurement (GreenField) & Connor (Redwood) — target: 2026-05-24
4) Commercial review & SOW draft — owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) — target: 2026-05-28
5) Exec signoff & PO issuance — owner: GreenField CFO/Procurement — target: 2026-06-08

Open decision criteria (what they told us):
- Latency SLA under 150ms 95th percentile for their inference workload (non-negotiable)
- Unit cost target ~ $0.004/token equivalent (target, +/- 20%)
- Data residency: U.S. only for production datasets

Notes for the team: Ben — pricing + SOW draft please. Evelyn — can you loop legal for a quick redline guardrails doc (we may need to offer a standard liability cap ask)?

Attachments: GF_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones), GF_security_requirements.pdf (SOC2 + retention summary).

On Sun, May 17, 2026 at 2:00 PM Sasha Miller <sasha@greenfieldai.com> wrote:
> Connor — thanks for taking the time. Miguel and I will coordinate the buying committee list and get back.
> 
> -Sasha

Connor — good notes, thanks. A couple of procurement items to flag (procurement copied):
- Can you provide SOC2 Type II report (redacted) and an exportable data retention policy? We may also need an IP/data processing addendum.
- Procurement sent a standard intake form (attached). Please fill out the vendor fields and return.
- Timeline: our preferred go-live for pilot infra is 2026-06-15; final production decision by 2026-07-01. Is that feasible?

Also, who would be Redwood's account owner post-contract (for onboarding)? We want a single point of contact for the pilot delivery.

Regards,

GreenField AI

Date: 2026-05-19 10:25 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenField AI — buy cycle playbook & proposed MAP

Thanks team — jumping in on the SOW and pricing side. A few items from my side: 
- I'll draft a one-page commercial summary (T&Cs, target pricing band, discounting rules) and link to the SOW. Expect draft by 2026-05-25.
- Pilot scoping: recommend a 4-week pilot with clearly defined success metrics (latency profile, cost per 1M tokens, qualitative integration checklist). If pilot go-live 2026-06-15, pilot wrap by 2026-07-13.
- Account owner: I'll be primary AE for contract & commercial handoff; onboarding/solutions delivery will be Monica Patel (cc not on this thread) — I'll introduce Monica in the SOW email.

Evelyn — any blocking legal terms we should surface early? My sense is standard cloud SaaS terms plus a short data processing addendum for the pilot.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

- We will surface the CFO (Rebecca Cole) for the commercial approval step — target availability week of 2026-06-01.
